purpose: Current-source paired H96 validation extension to ETTh2 and ETTm2 with linear, patch, periodic, transformer and Mamba baselines.
research_question: Does MambaTSv3AutoCon remain competitive on the held-out ETT variants when compared with current-source RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer and Mamba2?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only. No test metrics or predictions are generated. This extension cannot authorize a held-out release.
claim_boundary: This matrix cannot establish universal forecasting, causal AutoCon attribution, long-horizon superiority, or hardware-independent speed.

required_before_launch: verify two ETT fingerprints and exact 36-job expansion
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The candidate, baseline set, optimizer and budget are fixed before launch; no dataset-specific model or hyperparameter selection is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives AutoCon and prediction-connected representation fusion; baselines remain plain forecasting models.
capacity_fairness_contract.resource_boundary: Runtime and memory require separate fixed-shape prediction-only measurement.

phases.name: candidate_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate on ETTh2 and ETTm2.

phases.name: baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Current-source RLinear and strong nonlinear baseline references on the same ETTh2/ETTm2 cells.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report all ETTh2/ETTm2 rows and paired deltas within this current-source matrix; a held-out release requires a separate approved plan.

stopping_rules: Stop a dataset branch for publication claims if the candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest baseline.
Do not claim AutoCon causal gain without an exact lambda-zero mechanism screen.
Do not convert validation results into test claims.
prelaunch_gates: verify two ETT fingerprints and exact 36-job expansion
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root
